status: Main SDK source integrated through cb1c24aa; scoped owner long-media evidence accepted; installed release separate
purpose: Describe cuts, retiming, captions, effects, audio and measured edit selections without managing Native GPU buffers or temporary images.

units.sourceSampling: rational presentation seconds derived from project fps
units.transforms: existing Engine Transform and Signals, Stage FrameContext

functions.name: video
functions.input: Resource id, project-relative path, source dimensions and optional decoding/color policy

defaults.interpretation: tagged Rec709, display reference white 100 nits

functions.limits: Existing tagged planar YUV importer profile; hardware requires its admitted runtime and never falls back.

functions.name: image
functions.input: Resource id, path, source dimensions and optional decoding/alpha policy
functions.limits: Surface-v2 input currently requires scene-linear Rec709 and an explicit matching Alpha convention.

functions.name: clip
functions.input: EditAsset and duration; optional from/fit/sampling/transform

functions.name: splitClip
functions.input: EditClip and interior project-frame offset
functions.output: Two clips retaining the original source sampling

functions.name: sequence
functions.input: Clips in authored order

functions.name: at
functions.input: Project frame and clip

functions.name: speedClip
functions.input: Affine video clip and rate multiplier; optional duration override

defaults.duration: ceil(previous duration / abs(multiplier)); zero holds first sample

functions.limits: Image stream only. Audio and optical flow are not implicitly generated.

functions.name: reverseClip
functions.input: Affine video clip
functions.output: Same source samples in reverse order
functions.limits: Retains existing decoder seek costs.

functions.name: freezeClip
functions.input: Affine clip, sample offset and optional output duration

functions.name: remapClip
functions.input: Video clip, existing Core Signal/keyframes of absolute source project-frame positions
functions.limits: Evaluated against actual Stage FrameContext. Cannot also use from/speed; invalid or out-of-source samples fail.

functions.name: editingStage
functions.input: fps and tracks, optional duration/background/float format
functions.output: Named exported Native Stage factory with a resident edit plan
functions.limits: Use a named ESM export. Reuses current Native factory identity; no serialized closure or new execution protocol.

functions.name: editComposition
functions.input: width/height/fps/tracks and a named Native Stage factory
functions.limits: One clip or an explicitly declared two-clip transition per track; extra tracks are overlays. Audio remains round 5.

functions.name: createEditingStage
functions.input: Existing admitted NativeStageInit; optional cancellation signal
functions.ownership: Borrows scope; returned GPU image owned by caller; logically releases all intermediates. Session retains completion and recovery.

functions.name: inspectFootage
functions.input: Explicit local file path and metadata policy
functions.output: Typed VideoAsset plus actual media probe
functions.limits: Node host preparation only; does not bypass Resource declarations or source seals.

functions.name: parseSubtitles
functions.input: SRT/basic WebVTT source and explicit markup/settings policies
functions.limits: Canonical three-digit milliseconds; no full WebVTT CSS/regions or ASS.

functions.name: subtitleFrames
functions.input: SubtitleCue and project fps

defaults.rounding: ceil both endpoints to preserve visibility at project sample times

functions.name: shiftSubtitles
functions.input: Cues and integer millisecond offset

functions.name: prepareSubtitles
functions.input: Cues, viewport/fps, borrowed admitted typography provider or source services, optional style
functions.output: Edit tracks plus structured preparation diagnostics
functions.limits: Actual source services and frozen official Node preparation SDK seam tested. Does not grant WASM or dispose borrowed providers. Full Engine SDK distribution is Main's integration scope.

functions.name: prepareTitle
functions.input: Text and borrowed typography preparation service
functions.output: TextAsset with original canonical paragraph geometry
functions.limits: Prepare explicitly in Node. Font size/wrap are preparation values; transform/opacity remain animated clip parameters.

functions.name: preparedText
functions.input: Existing real PreparedParagraphMeshes plus ink/placement/plate
functions.limits: No invented glyph boxes. Geometry prepared in resident Stage initialization before owner seed sealing.
Stage owns format, Alpha, working color and cancellation. Other defaults and parameter bounds are the original algorithm contracts. GPU required.
functions.input: One of twenty existing image algorithms and its original typed options
functions.name: effect
withEffects
functions.output: New clip retaining its time, fit and transform
functions.limits: Effects run after fit/transform and before clip opacity. Blur radius uses composition pixels.
functions.input: EditClip and ordered effect calls

functions.name: transition
functions.limits: No handles invented. Overlap must fit both clips; triple overlap fails. Optional progress is a Core Signal.
functions.input: crossDissolve, fadeThroughColor, directionalWipe, irisWipe or pushTransition, duration in project frames, optional original controls

functions.name: sequenceWithTransitions
functions.limits: Duration is sum of clips minus overlaps. Reuses original source head/tail frames, without hidden extra handles.
functions.input: Declared clips, one transition or an array of nullable boundary transitions

functions.name: audioSource
functions.input: Resource id, local source path, output sampleRate/layout/sampleCount, optional audio stream ordinal and explicit conversion
functions.limits: Uses existing Core init.audio interval service when present. Legacy Core keeps small-WAV limits and rejects unavailable stream/conversion. Compressed sampleCount is an authored source view, not a claim of exact decoded duration. Actual reads verify full coverage; no time stretching.

functions.name: audioClip
functions.input: EditAudioSource, project-frame from/duration or sample-precise fromSamples, optional Core gain/pan Signals and fade frame counts
functions.limits: Choose from or fromSamples. No hidden resampling, extraction, speed/pitch processing or source-boundary clamping. Existing mixer evaluates at absolute sample coordinates.

functions.name: audioAt
functions.input: Project frame and EditAudioClip
functions.limits: Overlaps mix through existing AU-1 mixer; library does not create a second mixer.

functions.name: audioSequence
functions.input: Audio clips
functions.limits: Each placed clip lowers into an ordinary Stage time mapping and Layer trim/gain/pan. Existing worker/resource costs remain.

functions.name: audioComposition
functions.input: fps, audio tracks, optional finite duration/seed
functions.limits: Public create exports WAV without requesting a visual frame. A/V uses editComposition({...,audio:[...]}) instead.

functions.name: inspectAudioSource
functions.input: Explicit local WAV path and optional baseDirectory/cancellation
functions.limits: Uses existing WAV IO inspector and its retained budget. Does not authorize Resource access or convert compressed audio.

functions.name: inspectAudioResource
functions.input: Borrowed genuine sealed Core AudioResourceReader, declared Resource id/path and optional output profile/stream/conversion
functions.limits: Caller owns/closes reader. Whole PCM is never loaded. Exact WAV sample counts are converted to complete output samples; compressed/container input requires explicit intended sampleCount and actual interval coverage. Does not admit an arbitrary file path.

functions.name: analyzeEditSource
functions.input: Project-scoped local media, projectRoot and explicit parameter/resource budgets
functions.output: Existing C3 AnalysisResult plus authenticated EditCues
functions.limits: First video/audio stream; finite media duration and usable stream alignment required. CPU analysis, no JS pixels/full PCM. Silence timestamps retain backend text precision; RMS candidates are not musical beats or semantic recognition. Public Analysis catalog registration remains Main work.

functions.name: readEditCues
functions.input: Explicit C3 cache root and SHA256 artifact key
functions.limits: Checks C3 manifest/files, hashes the consumed bytes again, validates source identity; no stat-only cache trust.

functions.name: verifyCueSource
functions.input: Cues and explicit project-scoped source path
functions.limits: Run before generating edits from persisted recommendations; source changes require reanalysis.

functions.name: sceneRanges
functions.input: Validated EditCues with real video analysis
functions.output: Half-open source intervals partitioned by measured cuts

functions.name: audibleRanges
functions.input: Validated audio cues and padding/join/minimum seconds
functions.limits: Audible-content selection, not speech recognition; missing audio is an error and empty selection stays empty.

functions.name: snapToOnsets
functions.input: Cues, source cut times and maximum distance
functions.output: Nearest candidate times with explicit matched/unmatched flags
functions.limits: Windowed RMS-rise candidates, not a tempo model.

functions.name: clipsFromRanges
functions.input: VideoAsset, source ranges, fps, optional fit/transform/effects and rounding
functions.limits: sample uses ceil/ceil membership; cover uses floor/ceil coverage and may repeat adjacent boundary frames. Apply normal time helpers afterward.

functions.name: audioFromRanges
functions.input: EditAudioSource, matching source ranges/fps/rounding and explicit audioOffsetSeconds
functions.output: Matching Audio clips with sample-precise source starts
functions.limits: Offset must fit source samples. Reuses normal AU-1 Stage props/local AudioBlock coordinates; no new clock or sampler.

effectLifecycle.internal: same Stage and borrowed Native GPU owner; original recipe processor, F32 PM scene-linear Rec709 internal images
effectLifecycle.final: declared F16/F32 publication; no-effect/no-transition path retains its previous format
effectLifecycle.order: source sampling, fit/transform, clip effects, clip opacity, transition, track source-over, final effects, format publication
effectLifecycle.publication: one owned GPU publication at end of each nonempty effect chain; no CPU readback or Canvas
effectLifecycle.disposal: original recipe retains its result until next use/dispose; edit publishes a separate owned result; caller owns final output; logical release is not GPU completion

dependencies: existing Native GPU scope and Resource service
permissions: No automatic trust, WASM grants, browser startup or private file access.
